suggestions: Replace the rolling correlation with an additive joint-elevation score gated by continuous trend strength: Rank(Diff(volume,10)/Ts_Mean(volume,60)) + Rank(Diff((high-low),10)/Ts_Mean((high-low),60)), multiplied by Rank(Diff(close,60)/Ts_Std(close,60)) instead of Sign(Diff(close,60)). Correlation ranks stocks by co-movement shape alone, leaving many names in middle quintiles with similar coefficients but divergent forward returns and compressing the signal into noisy tails; an additive elevation score monotonically rewards simultaneous above-baseline participation and range expansion scaled by trend intensity, spreading names across quintiles by economic conviction rather than binary regime flips and improving both Q5–Q1 spread and dual-leg contribution.

Require joint expansion in both legs before scoring high, using a bottleneck rather than correlation alone: Min(Rank(Diff(volume,10)), Rank(Diff((high-low),10))) * Sign(Diff(close,60)), optionally normalized by each stock's own 60-day median rank. Correlation can spike when only one leg moves (e.g., volume spike without range confirmation, or range widening on low volume), pushing such names into extreme quintiles where forward returns mean-revert and break Q4–Q5 monotonicity; a minimum-of-ranks structure ensures Q5 contains stocks where both participation and intraday range genuinely expand together, so the long leg earns returns from conviction on both dimensions rather than the short leg carrying the spread.

Condition the co-movement measure on magnitude, not correlation sign alone: Corr(Rank(Diff(volume,10),60), Rank(Diff((high-low),10),60), 60) * Sign(Diff(close,60)) * Greater(Abs(Diff(volume,10)), Ts_Mean(Abs(Diff(volume,10)),60)). Stocks with mechanically high rank-correlation on tiny daily changes populate high and low signal buckets with weak predictive power, flattening middle-quintile returns and lowering long-short Sharpe; filtering to sessions where volume change exceeds its recent average magnitude retains the participation–range alignment thesis while excluding microstructure noise that decorrelates bucket returns from signal rank.
